alt: A message written to a session of the ELU terminal app that is still working: the line under it changes to Read, then answered, and the answer shows under it while the turn keeps working.

frames.caption: A session is working on your request.
You write to it while it works.
ELU sends your message to the running turn.
The turn reads it at its next step.
The answer shows at once. The turn keeps working.
